message:
release: 0.2.153 -- the updater only stops this install's own files; the clip helper exits on WM_CLOSE

PC only. After 0.2.152 failed to install on this PC (2026-10-08: AbandonedBeforeSwap, "orphaned windowless
pid 9752 did not exit" -- a GNLinkClipHelper.exe left over from a test build outside the install folder):
- updater: a process counts as the product only if its executable is the SAME FILE (volume + file index) as
  the installed payload of that name; a same-named copy elsewhere (or a backup copy inside the install
  folder) is no longer stopped or waited on. If either file cannot be opened the membership is Unknown and
  the swap is refused with the pid named -- never excluded as foreign, never asked to stop.
- clip helper: WM_CLOSE (what the updater sends) now ends the process; it used to destroy only the window
  and leave the helper running windowless. Every shutdown path sets a publish ban first, and a publish that
  started before the close is withdrawn.
The original 4 h survival of that helper and whether a WM_CLOSE reached it then are NOT established; this
fixes a reproduced path that ends in the same state (updater-helper-lifecycle t-ifrwiz0d, 8179e43..c42404d).
Verified: Codex OK on c42404d; verifier's independent build -- real processes A/B/C through PrepareForSwap
(A asked, B/C not; filter removed -> B/C asked; Unknown -> refused, flipped -> asked), update suite 15,
helper e2e 159/0 x2 (WM_CLOSE exit; publish after close does not commit); main integration 14 exit 0.
Known flaky, pre-existing: updater_exit_record_test (also fails 1 in 3 on 89155e4).

Product: version only (PC 0.2.152 -> 0.2.153; APK stays 0.2.26). Test: none. Docs: none.
